gloss: seventy percent in bloom; nearly full bloom

definitions.gloss: seventy percent in bloom; nearly full bloom
definitions.explanation: A stage of flowering when approximately 70% of the blossoms have opened. Part of the cherry blossom scale used in weather forecasts and hanami planning.

examples.japanese: {桜|さくら}は{七分咲|ななぶざ}きだ。
examples.english: The cherry blossoms are about seventy percent in bloom.

examples.japanese: {今週末|こんしゅうまつ}は{七分咲|ななぶざ}きの{予想|よそう}です。
examples.english: The forecast is for seventy percent bloom this weekend.

examples.japanese: {七分咲|ななぶざ}きの{桜|さくら}の{下|した}で{花見|はなみ}を{楽|たの}しんだ。
examples.english: We enjoyed cherry blossom viewing under trees that were nearly in full bloom.

notes:
Part of the traditional cherry blossom blooming scale ({開花|かいか} stages) used by the Japan Meteorological Agency and in daily conversation during spring. The scale progresses through stages from buds ({蕾|つぼみ}) to full bloom ({満開|まんかい}) to falling petals ({散|ち}り{始|はじ}め).

BLOOMING SCALE:
- {蕾|つぼみ}: buds
- {咲|さ}き{始|はじ}め: beginning to bloom
- {三分咲|さんぶざ}き: 30% bloom
- {五分咲|ごぶざ}き: 50% bloom (half bloom)
- {七分咲|ななぶざ}き: 70% bloom
- {満開|まんかい}: full bloom
- {散|ち}り{始|はじ}め: beginning to fall

USAGE:
Many people consider {七分咲|ななぶざ}き to be the most beautiful stage for {花見|はなみ}, as the blossoms are nearly full but the trees still have fresh buds opening.
